purpose: Visual language specification board — deconstructed opera mask pattern system and graphic elements
prompt:
Professional design specification board titled "视觉语言 Visual Language" for a Peking Opera face paint guochao merchandise brand called 脸谱潮 LIANPU CHAO.

Layout: Grid on rice-paper #f5f0e8 background, showing the deconstructed opera mask pattern system.

SECTION 1 — 额头图案解构 Forehead Pattern Deconstruction (top-left):
Geometric abstraction of traditional opera forehead patterns — Bao Zheng's crescent moon motif, Guan Yu's phoenix eye pattern — broken into bold geometric shapes with thick ink-black #1a1a2e outlines. Show the transformation from traditional to deconstructed.

SECTION 2 — 眼窝造型 Eye Socket Forms (top-right):
Three eye styles extracted from opera masks — phoenix eye (凤眼), tiger eye (虎眼), leopard eye (豹眼) — rendered as bold graphic elements with thick outlines. Each in different palette colors: cinnabar-red #e8433f, azurite-blue #2d6a8e, ink-black #1a1a2e.

SECTION 3 — 脸谱轮廓线 Face Outline System (middle):
Symmetrical face outline diagrams showing the three-section tile face (三块瓦脸) and cross-gate face (十字门脸) structure lines. Bold geometric simplification with thick strokes.

SECTION 4 — 装饰纹样 Decorative Patterns (bottom-left):
Traditional cloud patterns (云纹), flame patterns (火焰纹), bat patterns (蝙蝠纹) reinterpreted in guochao street art style — bold, graphic, with thick outlines and flat color fills in the 7-color palette.

SECTION 5 — 色块分割 Color Block Division (bottom-right):
Pop-art style color block compositions using the palette colors — showing how face paint color areas can be abstracted into bold geometric compositions.

Style: All elements use thick outlines (3-6px), flat color blocks only (no gradients), symmetrical compositions. Guochao street art energy. Professional design board layout. Brand name 脸谱潮 in corner.
